instructions.question: What emotional attitude does the poster of this Croatian tweet convey, judged from its tone and from the valence of what it reports or shares?
instructions.rule: Negative needs the poster to be bothered or attacking: their own complaint or suffering, annoyance, sarcasm aimed at a person or thing, or news of a bad event (crisis, debt, conflict, death, scandal), even if mild or with a smiley. Deadpan or witty observations with no target, playful banter, and calmly stated opinions, analysis or statistics are neutral. Shares and announcements of culture, events, entertainment, celebrities, tech, business deals, tips, jobs, products, calls to help, and warm replies are positive.

neutral.what: Pure facts, quotes, line-ups, statistics. Calm opinions or analysis about politics and society. Deadpan or witty everyday observations with no target, and playful banter or questions between friends.
examples: Mama gleda njemačku Bachelorette. Žena gleda američki Masterchef. Počinjem štedjet za treći televizor. (Mom watches German Bachelorette. My wife watches American Masterchef. I'm starting to save for a third TV.)
RT @321Kuhaj: Divljač se briše papirom, ne pere se vodom. #321kuhaj (Game meat is wiped with paper, not washed with water.)
neutral.cues: plain questions, numbers, line-ups, 'Eto' (there you go), 'mislim da' (I think), haha banter
neutral.not_for: The poster's own annoyance, or bad-news headlines, go negative. Shares inviting readers to events or content go positive.

positive.what: Joy, praise, thanks, warmth, anticipation. Shares and announcements of events, culture, celebrities, tech, business deals, articles, jobs, products, help appeals, nice check-ins.
examples: Pula: Na Giardinima započela 8. Florija, sajam cvijeća u sklopu obilježavanja Dana Grada: https://t.co/6Jbezcjeer (Pula: the 8th Florija flower fair started at Giardini)
Facebook kupuje WhatsApp - cijena - 16 milijardi USD. http://t.co/hQzOMJraPK (Facebook buys WhatsApp for 16 billion USD)
RT @amaiia_hr: #Zagreb - Volonteri traže prijevoz do poplavljenih područja #poplave (Volunteers seek transport to flooded areas)
@msrsan evo, whatever happens znas da si voljen :P (whatever happens, you know you're loved)
positive.cues: premijera (premiere), festival, pobjeda (win), rekord (record), pročitajte (read), pomozimo (let's help), hvala (thanks), bravo, :), :D
positive.not_for: Smileys on complaints or digs go negative. Bare facts, quotes, line-ups and calm political news go neutral.

negative.what: The poster complains, suffers, is annoyed, sad or worried, insults or mocks someone, or uses targeted sarcasm. Also news of bad events: crises, debt, conflicts, deaths, scandals, failures.
examples: Naravno, opet kiša u Brusselsu. (Of course, rain in Brussels again.)
Oborili sve rekorde: vanjski dug Hrvatske veći nego ikad http://t.co/YXbdqvWN4o (Broke all records: Croatia's foreign debt higher than ever)
@LucijaCavric oho i ovdje si finjak :P (oho, you're being posh here too)
negative.cues: opet (again), jebiga (damn it), mrzim (I hate), sranje (crap), grozan (awful), gripa (flu), dug (debt), skandal (scandal), :(, :S
negative.not_for: Help appeals go positive. Witty observations with no target and calm opinions go neutral.
